śaraṇā
gatahaṃtus tu na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ kvacit
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā

te tathā
yannimittaṃ bhavec chokaḥ trāso vā duḥkham eva ca
athāso vā yaso mūlam ekāham iti tat tyajet

mariṣyā
mīti yad duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate
jñeyas tenānumānena paro pi parirakṣi|tuṃ

yathā ca te jīvitam ātmanaḥ priyaṃ tathā
pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ
tasmān nāham imaṃ bhītam arppayiṣye kapotakam
yad atra yuktam anyat te kartuṃ śyenāśu tad vada
prāyasaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ
mahatām api yajñānāṃ kālena niyataṃ phalaṃ

bhītābhayapradānasya kṣaya
eva na vidyate
dattam iṣṭaṃ yathā taptaṃ tīrthaṃ sevā śrutaṃ tathā
sarvāṇy abhayadānasya ka'lāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ

catuḥsā
garaparyyaṃtāṃ yo dadyatidyāt pṛthivīm imāṃ
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyaḥ tayor abhayado dhikaḥ

api tyaje rājyam idaṃ śarī
raṃ vā sudustyajaṃ
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃsatrastaṃ tyaje dīnaṃ kapotakam
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit kṛtaṃ janmani janmani

bha
vet trātābhayārttānāṃm ārttināśāya dehināṃ
nāhaṃ kāram ayaṃ rājyaṃ na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavam

prāṇināṃ duḥkhataptānāṃ kāma
ye duḥkhanāśanam
yathā ca nānṛtaṃ vācam aham evam udāhare
satyenānena gabhagavān prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ

āhārārthaṃ
samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama
tad yatheṣṭaṃ tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmy aham

ya eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bha
kṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ
tam evotsṛjya nāhāraiḥ kāryam anyair nareśvara
āhārārthaṃt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti nareśvara

āhā
reṇa vivarddhaṃte tena jīvaṃti jaṃtavaḥ
śakyate duṣkare py arthe ciraṃ rātreṇa jīvitiuṃ
na tv āhāravihīnena śakyaṃ vartayituṃ ciram
bhakṣyād vilopitasyāsya mama prāṇā mama viśāṃ pate
visṛjya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ

mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradā
raṃ mariṣyati
rakṣamāṇaṃ kapotaṃ tvaṃ vahūn prāṇān na rakṣasi
dharmmaṃ yo vādhate dharmmo na hi dharmmaḥ paraṃtapaḥ

avirodhī
tu yo dharmmaḥ sa dharmmaḥ sadbhir ucyate
tasmād virodhe dharmmasya viciṃtya gurulāghavaṃ

yato bhūyāt tato rājan kuru dharmmavi
nirṇayam
nāto dharmmaparo bhūyaḥ kaścid anyo sti khecaraḥ
prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃm abhayaṃ yat pradīyate

va
ram etasya satvasya dadyād ayabhabhayadakṣiṇāṃ
na tu viprasahasrasya gosahasrasya yat phalaṃ

abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo yo dadā
ti dayāparaḥ
tasya dehād vimuktasya na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit
hemadhenudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuvi

durllabhaḥ pu
ruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāparaḥ
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī

mā rājan_ sāra
tāṃ jñātvā kadalīskaṃdam āruha
nāhaṃ kuśāstramārgeṇa kvacid vartte vihaṃgama |

śāstrair evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dha
rmmaḥ satvadayāparaḥ
sarvasatveṣu yad dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā
sarvasatvapradānāt tu dayaikāsmin viśiṣyate

sa
rve vedā na tat kuryuḥ sarvayajñāś ca khecaraḥ
sarvatīrthābhiṣekaś ca yat kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā

vāṅmanaḥka|rmmabhir ye
tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
dayādarśitapaṃthāno vrahmalokaṃ vrajaṃti te
gachaṃtas tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapato pi vā

ya
n na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ
jaṃgamāni ca bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narāḥ

ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃti
paramāṃ gatiṃ
prāṇanaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tu yaḥ kaścit samupekṣate
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoram iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ

sumahat saphala
laṃ rājyaṃ praya'chāmi tava dvija
yadi kāmayase hy anyad varjjayitvā kapotakaṃ

yadi rājan_ kapote te su
dṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me

anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyā
ṣase
etat te saṃpradāsyāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi
yad a'priyaṃ tat sujanaś cirād vadati mānavaḥ

mama tu priyam evaitat kasmā
t te bhihitaṃ cirāt
adhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇavināśinā
dhruvaṃ yo nārjjayed dharmmaṃ sa śocyo mūḍhacetanaḥ

yadi
prāṇyupakārāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate
tataḥ kim upakāro sya pratyahaṃ kriyate vṛthā

nātiriktam ahaṃ yāce
tava māṃsaṃ nareśvara
tasmāt kapotena dhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā samaṃ

tad eva hi kariṣyāmi yan māṃ tvaṃ śyena
yācase
śyenasya rakṣaṇaṃ yan me tavāpi ca vihaṃgama
evam uktvā svamāṃsāni samutkṛtya sa pārthivaḥ
s tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabho
tyaktvātmasukhabhogechāṃ sarvasatvasukhaiṣiṇaḥ |

bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥ
khitāḥ
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādāt sa parthivaḥ

na vidyate anyad ya
dā māṃsaṃ kapotena samaṃ kvacit
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso yam āruroha svayaṃ tulāṃ |
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ

nā
pekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāṃty api
atha tasmin samārūḍhe tulām auśīnare nṛpe

papāta ha

pahṛtaṃ tvayā

akṛtvā

ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān yo naraḥ parirakṣati

varttate punaḥ

svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyeṣv anyeṣu kā kathā

paśavo

sa punar jīvita ślāghyo yaḥ parārthe ca jīvati

kiṃ vātra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānugra
hatatparā

paropakāravyāpāraparo yaḥ puruṣaḥ sadā

sa padaṃ tad avāpno
ti parād api hi yat paraṃ
paropakāraikadhiyaḥ svasukheṣu gataspṛhāḥ
jagaddhitāya jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi

t svamāṃsāni bhūtebhyaḥ samutkṛtāni pārthiva
iyaṃ te śāśvatī kīrtir lokān anucariśyati

gnī jagmatu tridaśālayam
